context_for_next_testing_agent: Search engine integration feature fully working. New endpoints: GET /api/search/engines (returns available engines and status), POST /api/search/collate now accepts 'engine' parameter ('all', 'duckduckgo', 'brave'). DuckDuckGo works out of the box. Brave requires BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY env var - when not configured, Brave option shows '(Not configured)' in dropdown and falls back to mock data. Frontend shows engine status badges and source badges on search results. Bing Search API was retired by Microsoft in August 2025, so only Brave was integrated as alternative.
